text:
maria: Starting canary for verdigris17b-v2 int4 on canary-3. Small pool. Noticing p95 higher than expected and a small eval drop on SQuAD. Anyone available to triage? :wave:

jake: can you paste the inference config + current routing policy?

maria: config:
```
model: verdigris17b-v2-int4
max_new_tokens: 320
microbatch_size: 16
batching: {max_batch_tokens: 5120, max_batch_wait_ms: 15}
kv_prefetch: on
cache_policy: default
```

owen: two quick things: int4 compute patterns can increase per-token kernel latency vs fp16; 16 microbatch might cause tail spikes. also we've seen slot churn on small heaps when bursty traffic hits KV prefetch.

sam: ran a quick local compare using same prompt set at 160/320 max_new_tokens:
- baseline (open-v1): p50 48ms p95 125ms tok/s 430
- verdigris@320: p50 75ms p95 230ms tok/s 275
- verdigris@160: p50 62ms p95 165ms tok/s 350
SQuAD EM: baseline 82.3, verd@320 80.6, verd@160 80.9
Lowering max_new_tokens helps latency with small quality hit.

maria: ok trying microbatch 8 and max_new_tokens 160. Also reduce max_batch_tokens.

owen: recommend microbatch_size=8, max_batch_wait_ms=8, max_batch_tokens=3072, enable slot_compactor heuristic (cwnd=0.7). Add short rollback rule if p95>180ms for 10m.

jake: +1. Also label in model card: default hosted max_new_tokens=160 while kernel perf improvements are tracked.

infra-bot: deploy: canary-config-update by maria applied to verdigris17b-v2-int4 on canary-3

maria: rolled config update. watching metrics.

sam: after 5m: p50 61ms p95 158ms tok/s 340. no OOMs observed. eval snapshot stable.

owen: good. Plan a 30m stress run tonight to compare 8-bit vs 4-bit quant paths focusing on KV-heavy prompts. Schedule 23:00 UTC.

maria: scheduled with feature-flag and rollback script. also creating ticket to capture async kernel traces and GPU occupancy for the 180-230ms p95 window.

jake: noted. I'll add the recommendation to the onboarding checklist and model card. Thanks all :thumbsup:
